Today we’re launching Portable Computer on @nvidia DGX Spark.

Portable Computer is a fully local version of Perplexity Computer, where the entire runtime: orchestrator LLM, subagent LLM, agent harness all run on your local hardware. No cloud dependency.

When a task needs frontier reasoning, the orchestrator asks for approval before routing it to a frontier model in the cloud.

It’s user-gated, PII-flagged, and text guidance only. Your sensitive documents stay on your device.

Portable Computer runs a post-trained and locally installed PPLX 27B model.

NVIDIA and AWS are expanding the partnership across the full stack — GPUs, CPUs, networking, open models and software — to make agentic and physical AI real at a pace and scale that only we can deliver together.

What that looks like:
 ➡️ 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS’s global infrastructure
 ➡️ NVIDIA Vera CPU coming to AWS for agentic AI
 ➡️ Faster, more power-efficient memory with NVLink Fusion with NVHBM
 ➡️ AI factories for the U.S. government, including 100,000 GPUs on secure AWS infrastructure

Demand is running ahead of every forecast and we’re building to match it.

A major upgrade for entry-level edge AI is on the way. 👀

Introducing the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 2, the robotics computer built to bring frontier intelligence to entry-level edge AI.
